scope: Post-close credit-card refund presentation and activity access
behavior: A refund is associated with a confirmed statement only when its original posted purchase belongs to that statement cycle and the refund posts after the statement close date
The issuer billed amount, allocated payment and remaining due are not rewritten by a later refund
The formal statement screen shows each later refund as an independent event and tells the user to reconcile it against a subsequent issuer statement
Each displayed refund opens the complete original-purchase activity family
The refund relation survives reopen, password restore and recovery-text restore
